label_construction_order: assemble official weekly evidence without algorithm dates
candidate_rule: first reviewed week with either an explicit official escalation from low/localised activity to region-wide rising activity, or at least two non-algorithm evidence domains
confirmation_rule: activity must persist in the following week; across the candidate and confirmation weeks there must be at least two evidence domains and at least one quantitative or pathogen-specific item
scale_rule: national references are compared only with national outputs
interpretation_limit: supports external temporal concordance only; does not estimate city-level accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, PR-AUC, or calibration
